about.title: About me
about.description1: I am a <bold>Senior Full Stack & Mobile Engineer</bold> specialized in building high-impact digital solutions. With over 5 years of experience, my journey is guided by the constant pursuit of uniting <gold>scalable architecture</gold> with <gold>exceptional user experiences</gold>. Beyond web and cloud systems, I am passionate about creating and publishing <bold>mobile applications on the Google Play Store</bold>.
about.description2: I currently lead the development of complex ecosystems, from architectural design in the cloud to the implementation of immersive interfaces on frontend and mobile. My main stack involves <bold>React, React Native, Next.js, Node.js and AWS</bold>.
about.description3: I am driven by technical challenges and fascinated by the intersections between software engineering and artificial intelligence applied to the real world.
